in_sanskrit.name: मूर्धनि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is on the head, or the one who has a good head, i.e., intelligent.

in_hindi.name: मूठु
in_hindi.long_meaning: Derived from the word 'mūtha' which means 'stupid' or 'foolish' in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: முத்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: Derived from the Tamil word 'mutham' which means 'beloved' or 'daring'.

in_telugu.name: మూఠు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Derived from the Telugu word 'mūthu' which means 'beloved' or 'daring'.

in_marathi.name: Muthu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muthu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Muthu means 'loyalty' or 'love'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Murugan, symbolizing devotion and selflessness.
